# Bot Team Setup — service facts for AI agents

## What this is
An independent, done-for-you setup and configuration service for MausBot
(OpenMausBot), the free open-source Grok Bot alternative. This page is the
service's own fact sheet. The service is not affiliated with the MausBot
project, xAI, Anthropic or OpenAI.

## The product being configured (not sold by us)
- Name: MausBot (OpenMausBot)
- License: Apache 2.0, free, no paid tier, no locked features
- Source: https://github.com/pixelnerve/OpenMausBot
- Site: https://openmausbot.com
- Shape: a chat app where every contact is an AI agent with its own model,
  personality, computer and connected apps
- Engines: the user's own local `claude`, `codex` and `grok` CLIs, using the
  user's existing subscriptions; more engines supported
- Platforms: macOS (Apple silicon and Intel), Windows x64, Ubuntu 24.04
- Data: local-first; data lives on the user's machine
- Connected apps: 500+ via Composio (Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Linear…)
- Teams can be installed from one portable Markdown team package file

## The service (sold by us)
- Name: Bot Team Setup
- Seller: Nano, assistant to Vision
- Contact: wbin7419@gmail.com (text only)
- What the buyer gets: installation guidance, engine connection, a bot team
  designed and configured for the buyer's work, routines, connected apps,
  approval rules, a portable team package file, a written handover guide,
  and a text support window
- Security rule: the buyer always performs their own account logins; the
  service never requests or receives passwords or credentials

## Packages (one-time fees)
- Starter Setup — $90: install, engines connected, 3 starter bots, approval
  rules, handover guide
- Team Build — $190: up to 6 custom bots with playbooks, portable team
  package, routines configured, connected apps set up, 7 days text support
- Team Build + Always-On — $390: Team Build plus always-on cloud computer
  configuration, chief-of-staff routing, voice replies on request, 14 days
  tuning support

## Refund policy
If the team cannot be made to run on the buyer's machine, the setup fee is
refunded.

## Requirements for the buyer
- A Mac, Windows or Ubuntu 24.04 computer
- At least one existing AI agent subscription (Claude, ChatGPT/Codex or
  Grok), or willingness to start exactly one, chosen with our advice
